title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
description: A boss gauntlet that punishes slow reactions. Prior agent work covers isolated fights; nobody has reported story progress yet.
clear_condition: Defeat the final boss of any ending (Isshin, the Sword Saint, or the Shura ending's final fight).
rules: Unmodified game, any patch (state it). No trainers, no frame-rate or game-speed mods unless disclosed under game speed. Bosses may be claimed in any order.

milestones.name: Final boss of any ending
milestones.description: Isshin, the Sword Saint, or the Shura ending's final fight

attempts.name: CombatVLA
attempts.result: A small vision-language-action model trained for combat: game frames in, keyboard and mouse out, with the game paused while it thinks. Tested zero-shot on three Sekiro fights, the hardest being the mini-boss Shigenori Yamauchi, alongside 10 Black Myth: Wukong fights.
attempts.why_not: Isolated fights. Shigenori Yamauchi is a mini-boss, not one of this board's bosses, and no story progress is reported.
